issues.description: The UML in the problem statement marks getTotalNumberOfStudents() as public (shown with a '+' in the UML and described in the tasks), but the solution implementation declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as protected. This visibility mismatch between the specification (problem statement) and the solution can confuse students about the intended API and may cause unexpected access issues or test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Align visibility across artifacts. Either make getTotalNumberOfStudents() public in the solution/template to match the UML and problem description, or update the UML/problem statement to specify protected visibility. Prefer making the method public to match the UML and expected public API for the exercise.
